newsitem.title: FRANCE: French, Spanish police hold five on drugs offences.
newsitem.headline: French, Spanish police hold five on drugs offences.

text.p: French and Spanish police have arrested five French nationals suspected of drug trafficking, police said on Friday.

Police said 480 kg (1,060 lbs) of hashish, one million francs ($200,000) and several weapons were seized in raids carried out since late November in Paris, the French Riviera capital Nice and in Spain.
After the swoops in France which yielded two arrests, police identified two other suspected members of the drugs ring who had sought refuge in Irun in Spain.

On January 21, French and Spanish police seized a suspected drugs courier as he crossed the Hendaye border-post with 250 kg (550 lbs) of hashish in the boot of a stolen car carrying false number plates.
The courier and the two men based at Irun were being held under Spanish custody and France will soon seek their extradition, police said.
